tests.name: MHPCO Claim Office quote with an empty item list -- premium 5 G (processing fee only)
MHPCO Claim Office quote for a single plain sword -- premium 115 G (100 base + 10 first insurance + 5 fee)
MHPCO Claim Office quote for a single plain amulet -- premium 71 G (60 base + 6 first insurance + 5 fee)
MHPCO Claim Office quote for a single plain staff -- premium 93 G (80 base + 8 first insurance + 5 fee)
MHPCO Claim Office quote for a single plain potion -- premium 49 G (40 base + 4 first insurance + 5 fee)
MHPCO Claim Office quote for 1 rune -- base premium 25 G
MHPCO Claim Office quote for 2 runes -- base premium 50 G (no block)
MHPCO Claim Office quote for 3 runes -- base premium 60 G (block applies)
MHPCO Claim Office quote for 4 runes -- base premium 100 G (no block; block requires exactly 3)
MHPCO Claim Office quote for 7 runes -- base premium 175 G (no block; block requires exactly 3)
MHPCO Claim Office quote for 1 moonstone -- base premium 25 G (moonstone priced like a rune)
MHPCO Claim Office quote for 3 moonstones -- base premium 60 G (block applies to moonstones too)
MHPCO Claim Office quote for 2 runes + 1 moonstone -- base premium 75 G (no block: different types)
MHPCO Claim Office quote for 3 runes + 3 moonstones -- base premium 120 G (two separate blocks)
MHPCO Claim Office quote for a cursed sword -- curse adds 50 G (50 % of the item's base premium)
MHPCO Claim Office quote for a sword with enchantment 5 -- high-enchantment surcharge 30 G applies (threshold is >= 5)
MHPCO Claim Office quote for a sword with enchantment 4 -- no high-enchantment surcharge
MHPCO Claim Office quote for a cursed sword with enchantment 5 -- both surcharges apply (50 G + 30 G)
MHPCO Claim Office quote for a customer with exactly 2 years with MHPCO -- 20 % loyalty discount applies
MHPCO Claim Office quote for a customer with 1 year with MHPCO -- no loyalty discount
MHPCO Claim Office quote always adds the 10 % first-insurance surcharge, regardless of customer history
MHPCO Claim Office second quote in a scenario -- 15 % follow-up-contract discount on the policy base premium
MHPCO Claim Office third quote in a scenario -- 15 % follow-up-contract discount also applies
MHPCO Claim Office quote for a cursed sword + plain amulet -- policy base 160 G, curse adds 50 G (only the cursed item's base) -> 210 G before further modifiers and fee
MHPCO Claim Office quote whose raw premium is 197.5 G -- final premium 198 G (rounded up)
MHPCO Claim Office quote keeps intermediate amounts as fractions and rounds only the final premium
MHPCO Claim Office newcomer (0 years) with a cursed steel sword enchantment 3 -- premium 165 G
MHPCO Claim Office long-standing customer (3 years), second quote, cursed steel sword enchantment 7 -- premium 160 G
MHPCO Claim Office quote with an unknown item type (broomstick) -- CLI exits non-zero, error on stderr, no results on stdout
MHPCO Claim Office policy covering a sword and an amulet -- insurance sum 1600 G, cap 3200 G
MHPCO Claim Office policy covering two swords -- insurance sum 2000 G, cap 4000 G
MHPCO Claim Office policy covering a sword and 3 runes -- insurance sum 1750 G (block discount affects premium only), cap 3500 G
MHPCO Claim Office cursed sword with premium 165 G -- cap 2000 G (based on unmodified insurance value)
MHPCO Claim Office claim on a steel sword enchantment 3, damage 500 G -- payout 400 G (full minus 100 G deductible)
MHPCO Claim Office claim on a rune (no enchantment, no material), damage 200 G -- payout 100 G (full minus deductible)
MHPCO Claim Office claim with damage below the deductible -- payout 0 G, never negative
MHPCO Claim Office claim on a steel sword enchantment 9, damage 1000 G -- payout 400 G (50 % first, then deductible)
MHPCO Claim Office claim on a steel sword enchantment 8, damage 1000 G -- payout 400 G (threshold is >= 8)
MHPCO Claim Office claim on a steel sword enchantment 7, damage 1000 G -- payout 900 G (no high-enchantment clause)
MHPCO Claim Office claim on a dragon-material sword enchantment 5, damage 800 G -- payout 700 G (full reimbursement, then deductible)
MHPCO Claim Office claim on a dragon-material sword enchantment 9, damage 1000 G -- payout 400 G (50 % rule wins over dragon material)
MHPCO Claim Office claim on a dragon-material sword enchantment 8, damage 1000 G -- payout 400 G (high-enchantment clause applies, then deductible)
MHPCO Claim Office dragon attack damaging a sword (500 G) and an amulet (300 G) -- payout 600 G (deductible once per damaged item)
MHPCO Claim Office policy covering two swords, damages listing two sword entries -- each entry gets its own deductible
MHPCO Claim Office sword policy (cap 2000 G), first claim of 1500 G -- payout 1400 G, remainingCap 600 G
MHPCO Claim Office sword policy (cap 2000 G), second claim of 1500 G -- payout 600 G, remainingCap 0 G (reduced to remaining cap)
MHPCO Claim Office claim whose raw payout is 350.5 G -- final payout 350 G (rounded down)
MHPCO Claim Office claim naming an item not in the policy (amulet when only a sword is insured) -- CLI exits non-zero with error on stderr
MHPCO Claim Office claim naming an unknown item type -- CLI exits non-zero with error on stderr
MHPCO Claim Office claim with more damage entries of a type than the policy covers (two sword damages, one sword insured) -- CLI exits non-zero, whole claim rejected
MHPCO Claim Office claim with a damage entry of amount -200 -- CLI exits non-zero with error on stderr
MHPCO Claim Office CLI reads the schema example from stdin and writes {results:[{premium},{payout,remainingCap}]} to stdout
MHPCO Claim Office CLI processes steps sequentially so a claim refers to the policy of its quote step by zero-based index
